fee_aware_take.rule: sum(expected-close minus current ask) > sum exact five-lot taker fees

commitment.probability_spec: P(first price + sibling reachable price + fees < pair budget | joint causal state)
commitment.threshold_reason: requires operator-specified naked-risk utility/max holding loss plus a calibrated joint sibling-reach distribution; expected close alone is insufficient

take_vs_rest.required_model: conditional seller-aggressed arrival hazard at-or-through proposed bid during intended residence, including queue-ahead and cancellation state
take_vs_rest.decision_spec: rest only when expected maker value from calibrated fill hazard exceeds cross-now value net of fee; otherwise cross only when calibrated expected-close distribution clears fee/risk
